p071_results_against_spec_prediction: TWO results contradict the spec's own predictions and are published as measured, not retuned away. (1) A one-line closed form using the same features and NO training step beats the learned random forest on two of three populations: recall 1.00000 vs 0.98840 and 0.99784 at ~1 per cent FPR. The forest leads only on the population it was trained on, by +0.01551. The spec predicted a Mahalanobis threshold would match the model; it does not - it is the WORST analytic screen at 0.03436 - and the measured reason is that Mahalanobis is invariant to R/sigma_eff, which spans 3.92 decades on that population and 0.26 where the same screen recovers to 0.83720. (2) One validation check FAILS and ships as failed: learned probabilities miscalibrated, worst reliability-bin gap 0.272 against a 0.15 tolerance. NOT repaired, because recall at fixed FPR depends only on score ordering and is invariant under monotone recalibration. Stated in README, VALIDATION.md and MODEL_CARD.md as: the predicted probability is usable as a ranking and is not usable as a probability.
p071_equation_defects: Six defects found by Hypothesis and NONE by the hand-written tests; four are defects in the published equations as literally transcribed. An absolute quadrature tolerance destroying scale invariance (5.3 per cent disagreement between a geometry and the same geometry scaled by 19, both values wrong); the published erf chord mass cancelling to exactly 0.0 where the answer is 8.77e-111; Chan's finite exponential sum losing 12 significant figures to cancellation; Chan's recommended series order of 3 being 15 per cent wrong at M=12. All six pinned as named regression tests with literal inputs.
p072_most_serious_defect_of_the_night: Unscaled capacity rows - coefficients ~1e9 against an objective ~1e1 - made HiGHS return status == 0 TOGETHER WITH an objective BELOW the true optimum on 12 of 240 instances, worst 0.457 relative. A solver reporting success while returning a wrong answer is the failure mode a self-validating implementation cannot see; it was visible only because the spec required a solver-free exhaustive enumeration as ground truth. Each capacity row is now divided by its window capacity. This is the strongest evidence yet for the mission rule that the implementer is never the sole validator of its own critical numerical claims.
p072_ai_verdict: Splits, and both halves reported. The declared-value baseline wins where the spec predicted - best non-oracle arm when declarations are complete and fresh (regret 0.000404) and in no other scenario; one refinement is that the learned model also helps where declarations are STALE, not only absent. The learned compressibility model beats every baseline (0.9628 of oracle value at 0.000000 overflow, vs 0.9003 per-instrument constant and 0.8276 entropy floor), and along the way measured that the entropy floor is NOT a lower bound for a correlated source: 0.9978 of held-out products compress below it. Both uncertainty outputs explicitly NOT calibrated: +-2 sigma coverage 0.947 and 0.885 against nominal 0.9545.
